content.json:
# AI Usage Summary (Armis-style)
> **Data sources:** `DeviceNetworkEvents` (MDE network telemetry) joined against the Sentinel watchlist **`AI-App-Domains`** (Domain, AppName, RiskScore, Risk[, Category]).
>
> **Window:** fixed 90-day lookback in every query below (`ago(90d)`), independent of any time-range picker.
>
> **Honesty note:** `DeviceNetworkEvents` does not include an HTTP method or User-Agent field. "Method" and "UserAgent" columns in Section D are derived from `InitiatingProcessFileName` (the real process making the connection) as an explicit, labeled proxy — not fabricated data. If you connect a web proxy (Zscaler, Palo Alto, etc.) that logs real HTTP telemetry via `CommonSecurityLog`, swap that in per the comment in the base query.
>
> **Normalisation:** domain-to-service consolidation (e.g. `chatgpt.com` + `openai.com` → "OpenAI/ChatGPT") happens by giving both watchlist rows the same `AppName`. Category (Enterprise / Consumer / Developer Tool / High-Risk) uses the watchlist's optional `Category` column if populated, otherwise falls back to keyword/risk-based inference — see Setup below.
## A. AI Service Usage Summary — Last 90 Days

content.query:
let AIApps = union isfuzzy=true (_GetWatchlist('AI-App-Domains')
    | project
        Domain    = column_ifexists('Domain', SearchKey),
        AppName   = column_ifexists('AppName', ''),
        RiskScore = toint(column_ifexists('RiskScore', '6')),
        Risk      = column_ifexists('Risk', 'Medium'),
        Category  = column_ifexists('Category', '')  // optional watchlist column; '' if not present
    | where isnotempty(Domain));
let AppDomains = AIApps | project Domain;
let Events =
    union isfuzzy=true
        DeviceNetworkEvents,
        (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime, RemoteUrl:string, ActionType:string,
                   InitiatingProcessAccountUpn:string, InitiatingProcessAccountDomain:string,
                   InitiatingProcessAccountName:string, InitiatingProcessFileName:string,
                   DeviceName:string) [])
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(90d)
    | where ActionType != "InboundInternetScanInspected"
    | extend CleanHost = tolower(trim_start(@"www.", tostring(parse_url(RemoteUrl).Host)))
    | where isnotempty(CleanHost)
    | extend Domain2 = extract(@"([a-zA-Z0-9-]+\.[a-zA-Z]{2,})$", 1, CleanHost)
    | extend Domain3 = extract(@"([a-zA-Z0-9-]+\.[a-zA-Z0-9-]+\.[a-zA-Z]{2,})$", 1, CleanHost)
    | where Domain2 in (AppDomains) or Domain3 in (AppDomains)
    | extend MatchDomain = iff(Domain3 in (AppDomains), Domain3, Domain2)
    | join kind=inner AIApps on $left.MatchDomain == $right.Domain
    // Canonical service name — normalisation (e.g. chatgpt.com + openai.com -> "OpenAI/ChatGPT")
    // happens at the watchlist level: give both domains the same AppName when you populate it.
    | extend Service = AppName
    | extend UserName = coalesce(
        InitiatingProcessAccountUpn,
        iff(isnotempty(InitiatingProcessAccountDomain),
            strcat(InitiatingProcessAccountName, "@", InitiatingProcessAccountDomain),
            InitiatingProcessAccountName))
    | where isnotempty(UserName)
        and UserName !contains "SYSTEM" and UserName !endswith "$" and UserName !startswith "NT AUTHORITY"
    // AccessType: DeviceNetworkEvents has no HTTP method/User-Agent column.
    // InitiatingProcessFileName is the closest REAL signal available for API/script vs browser.
    // If you connect a web proxy (Zscaler/Palo Alto) via CommonSecurityLog, prefer its real
    // HTTP method/UA fields instead — union them in here with column_ifexists() guards.
    | extend AccessType = case(
        InitiatingProcessFileName has_any ("chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","opera.exe","brave.exe","safari"), "Browser",
        InitiatingProcessFileName has_any ("python.exe","python3.exe","curl.exe","node.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","java.exe","php.exe","go.exe","ruby.exe"), "API/Script",
        InitiatingProcessFileName has_any ("Cursor.exe","Code.exe","code.exe","git.exe","docker.exe"), "Developer Tool",
        isempty(InitiatingProcessFileName), "Unknown",
        "Other Process")
    // Category: use watchlist Category column if populated, else infer from Service/Risk keywords
    | extend Category = case(
        isnotempty(Category), Category,
        Service has_any ("Copilot","M365 Copilot","Azure OpenAI"), "Enterprise",
        Service has_any ("Cursor","GitHub Copilot","Hugging Face","HuggingFace","Replit","Codeium","Tabnine"), "Developer Tool",
        Risk in ("Critical","High"), "High-Risk",
        "Consumer");
Events
| summarize DomainCount=count() by Service, MatchDomain
| sort by Service asc, DomainCount desc
| summarize ['Total Activities']=sum(DomainCount), TopDomains=make_list(MatchDomain) by Service
| extend ['Key Domains'] = strcat_array(array_slice(TopDomains, 0, 2), ", ")
| project Service, ['Total Activities'], ['Key Domains']
| sort by ['Total Activities'] desc
content.title: AI Service Usage Summary
Notable Observations

    // If you connect a web proxy (Zscaler/Palo Alto) via CommonSecurityLog, prefer its real
    // HTTP method/UA fields instead — union them in here with column_ifexists() guards.
    | extend AccessType = case(
        InitiatingProcessFileName has_any ("chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","opera.exe","brave.exe","safari"), "Browser",
        InitiatingProcessFileName has_any ("python.exe","python3.exe","curl.exe","node.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","java.exe","php.exe","go.exe","ruby.exe"), "API/Script",
        InitiatingProcessFileName has_any ("Cursor.exe","Code.exe","code.exe","git.exe","docker.exe"), "Developer Tool",

| where Risk in ("Critical","High","Medium")
| extend Reason = case(
    Service has_any ("DeepSeek","Qwen","Kimi","Baidu","ERNIE","Zhipu","Moonshot"),

    Category == "High-Risk", "Flagged high-risk by watchlist — unclear data handling/retention practices",
    Category == "Consumer" and Risk == "Medium", "Consumer-grade AI tool — limited enterprise controls, possible data leakage via free-tier terms",
    Category == "Developer Tool", "Developer AI tool — may transmit source code or credentials externally",
    Risk == "High", "High risk per watchlist scoring — review data handling",
    "Elevated risk — monitor for policy compliance")
| summarize Activities=count(), Users=dcount(UserName) by Risk, Service, Reason
| extend RiskOrder = case(Risk == "Critical", 1, Risk == "High", 2, Risk == "Medium", 3, Risk == "Low", 4, 5)
| sort by RiskOrder asc, Activities desc
| project ['Risk Level']=Risk, Service, Activities, Users, Reason

content.json:
## Setup Notes
**Recommended: add a `Category` column to the `AI-App-Domains` watchlist** (`Domain, AppName, RiskScore, Risk, Category`) with values `Enterprise`, `Consumer`, `Developer Tool`, or `High-Risk`, so Section C reasons and categorisation are explicit rather than inferred. If the column is absent, every query above falls back to a keyword/risk-score heuristic (visible in the `case()` logic) — functional, but less precise than an analyst-curated category per service.

**To consolidate domain variants under one service name** (e.g. `chatgpt.com` and `openai.com` both reporting as "OpenAI/ChatGPT"), give both watchlist rows the same `AppName` value — the queries group by that field directly, no extra mapping table needed.
